run_sample_main: run the sample module to generate structured text samples from a trained Transformer Grammars model using a checkpoint and tokenizer
sample_from_prefix: sample structured text from a trained model starting from a given prefix sequence with configurable temperature and number of steps
call_model_jitted: call the jitted model forward pass to compute logits and sample the next token given a chunk of input tokens
iterate_pretokenized_dataset: iterate over a pretokenized dataset file returning unbatched sequences of integer token IDs
build_forward_function: build a forward function from model config, masking rules, and token type ranges for inference with the Transformer Grammars model
